messages:
alex: FYI postmortem follow-up for 00:45 UTC KV OOM. Preliminary signal: high small-object allocation rate + slab cross-talk after shard-sync tweak. Short action list below. Claim items with ETA.

alex: Actions (short):
1) emergency soft-evict toggle (canary) -> owner: ? -> ETA: 6h
2) heap captures + flamegraphs on 3 nodes -> owner: ? -> ETA: 18h
3) lightweight fragmentation telemetry -> owner: ? -> ETA: 8h
4) quick pointer safety grep + audit of shard-sync -> owner: ? -> ETA: 36h
5) schedule allocator RFC if mitigations hold -> owner: ? -> ETA: next sprint

tess: I'll take (1). plan: set `kv.eviction.soft_pct=85` via config and deploy to 10% canary in eu-west-1. smoke tests post-deploy. ETA ~3h.

pranav: I'll do (2). will run `rdc heap-dump --svc=kv --duration=90` on nodes n1,n2,n3 and push flamegraphs to s3://dbg/kv/211234. ETA 12h.

sara: I'll own (4) pointer audit and pair with pranav once dumps exist. quick grep for casts + unsafe memcpy, then small test harness for pointer validity. ETA 30h.

pranav: question for telemetry: do we want `kv.frag_index = free_frag_bytes / used_bytes` or `kv.frag_ratio = free_frag_bytes / total_bytes`? also sample freq?

alex: prefer `kv.frag_index = free_frag_bytes / used_bytes` sampled every 15s per shard. alert if >0.28 for 10m. also emit `kv.small_alloc_per_min` for allocations <256B.

tess: added a tiny log event `EVT KV_SOFT_EVICT shard=%s pct=%d` and a metric `kv.soft_evict.count`. PR: https://git.redwood/runtime/pull/900. Canary deploy starting in 20m.

ops-bot: [automated] Created ticket POST-9123 "KV small-object churn follow-up" assigned to unassigned. Link: https://issue.redwood/POST-9123

pranav: started dumps on n1 (id hd-211234-n1). uploading now. will run flameviz and link when done.

alex: rollback criteria for canary: p99 > baseline + 20% OR srv.oom.count > 0 OR eviction error spikes > 50%. rollback command: `redwood deploy rollback --svc kv-runtime --to previous`. Document that in ticket.

sara: noted. after captures I'll run the pointer audit against sha `d4f7b2` and post findings. if nothing critical, recommend trying compaction heuristic `compact_threshold=0.18` in a follow-up canary.

pranav: uploaded flamegraphs for n1,n2. ids fg-211234-1/2. linking in ticket.

tess: canary healthy at 10% for 15m. no oom, soft_eviction events seen ~3/min for a few shards. monitoring p99.

alex: good. next check-in in 18h to confirm heap captures + pointer audit. if anyone hits blockers ping me. :thumbsup:
